name: Kimpton Rowan Palm Springs Hotel
insider_take: This sophisticated desert oasis captures Palm Springs' legendary mid-century glamour with a contemporary twist, perfectly positioned in the heart of the desert playground where Hollywood legends once escaped.
whats_special: The Kimpton Rowan features stunning 360-degree views from its rooftop pool and bar, showcasing the dramatic San Jacinto Mountains and sprawling desert landscape. The hotel's design pays homage to Palm Springs' golden age with sleek mid-century modern architecture, while the pet-friendly Kimpton hospitality includes complimentary wine hour and yoga mats in every room.
pro_tip: Visit the rooftop 4 Saints Bar during golden hour for Instagram-worthy sunset shots over the Coachella Valley – it's one of the highest vantage points in downtown Palm Springs.
dont_miss: Explore the famous Palm Springs Aerial Tramway just 10 minutes away, offering breathtaking rides up to 8,516 feet with panoramic desert views. The hotel is also walking distance to the Palm Springs Walk of Stars and the vibrant Uptown Design District filled with mid-century furniture shops and art galleries.
pros: Modern boutique hotel with striking contemporary design and rooftop pool with mountain views
Prime downtown Palm Springs location within walking distance to shopping and dining
Signature Kimpton pet-friendly policy with no additional fees
Complimentary evening wine hour and fitness center access
